project.title: Benjamin Cowen Just Flipped Bullish

model.title: This Bear Is Now Bullish on Bitcoin | Jason Pizzino
model.mechanism: One recognised bear, one behavioural change, one instantly understood promise.

thesis_sentences: Benjamin Cowen warned of a Q4 2025 Bitcoin top, sold much of his own stack, and stayed bearish into June 2026.
Now he is buying below $60K for the next bull market, even though he thinks the final cycle bottom may not arrive until October.

cards.label: This Bear Is Now Bullish
cards.source_title: This Bear Is Now Bullish on Bitcoin | Jason Pizzino
cards.quote: This Bear Is Now Bullish on Bitcoin
cards.why: Models the single-recognisable-bear plus behavioural-change click mechanism.
cards.missing: Without it, Benji cannot immediately see what proven packaging this video is modelling.

sections.section: He warned of the top, then sold

cards.label: Cowen forecast a Q4 cycle top and bear market
cards.source_title: Bitcoin: The Pattern That Historically Ended The Bull Market
cards.quote: Bitcoin ... goes into the market cycle top in Q4 of the post-halving year, which sets up the midterm-year bear market.
cards.why: Establishes the bearish cycle thesis before the final Q4 high.
cards.missing: Without it, the story begins after the market had already fallen.

cards.label: Cowen says his portfolio followed the bearish view
cards.source_title: Everyone Thinks the Bitcoin Cycle Is Dead... They're Wrong | Benjamin Cowen
cards.quote: I ended up selling off approximately that amount of my Bitcoin stack last year ... I wanted my investment portfolio to reflect that.
cards.why: Shows that his bearish thesis changed his own allocation, not only his commentary.
cards.missing: Without it, the sell-to-buy behavioural change is unsupported.
cards.caution: This is a retrospective disclosure. Exact sale dates, prices and quantity are not supplied.

cards.label: Cowen still called it the final bear-market stage in June
cards.source_title: Bitcoin Enters the 3rd Stage of the Bear Market
cards.quote: Bitcoin ... has entered the third and what I think is the final stage of the bear market.
cards.why: Proves the bearish view persisted immediately before the buying disclosure.
cards.missing: Without it, the story jumps from an old sale directly to buying.

cards.label: Cowen says the durable bottom may arrive around October
cards.source_title: Bitcoin: Where in the Cycle Are We?
cards.quote: That would probably be like late September through mid-December ... Why not October? ... Could very well be October.
cards.why: Defines the bottom window behind his new long-term positioning.
cards.missing: Without it, the reason he is willing to begin buying now is unclear.
cards.caution: This is a forecast, not confirmation that the bottom is already in.

cards.label: Cowen says he started buying below $60K
cards.source_title: Bitcoin: Where in the Cycle Are We?
cards.quote: I started buying a little bit back when we went below 60K ... Who cares if it goes lower later in the year? It probably will.
cards.why: This is the behavioural reveal promised by the title and thumbnail.
cards.missing: Without it, there is no direct evidence that Cowen's behaviour changed.
cards.caution: Exact execution date, average price and quantity are not supplied.

cards.label: Benjamin Cowen's Calls vs Bitcoin Price
cards.quote: Warned. Sold. Stayed bearish. Started buying.
cards.why: Lets a non-expert understand the entire thesis in one glance.
cards.missing: Without it, Benji must mentally combine separate clips and dates.
